title: add heuristic affordance index and rollback drafter
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: onboarding new model variants often lacks a concise, machine-readable signal to pick the right variant for common customer workloads (seq length, token prefixes, latency sensitivity). This PR introduces a lightweight "affordance index" produced during onboarding that captures runtime affordances (typical input length distribution, tokenized prefix fingerprints, latency bucket classification, and recommended quantization profile). The affordance index is used by the registry to: 1) recommend compatible variants for a given workload, 2) surface compatibility hints in the Console, and 3) enable automated rollback drafting if a rollout shows regression signals.

What this PR does (single-string description): adds an affordance indexer (registry/affordance_indexer.py) and persistent compact index schema; wires index generation into the onboard pipeline (onboard/steps.py); adds a rollback drafter (changelog/rollback_drafter.py) that synthesizes a short rollback note + remediation checklist when drift/regression alerts occur; exposes a minimal HTTP endpoint in the registry service for index lookups (api/index_lookup.py) used by the Console/CLI; includes unit and integration tests plus documentation draft.

Checklist: 
- [x] affordance index schema and storage adapter (compact JSON + gzip)
- [x] deterministic fingerprinting for prefix samples (stable across tokenizers)
- [x] pipeline hook and feature flag (onboard.affordance_index.enabled)
- [x] rollback drafter and changelog template generator
- [x] unit tests + lightweight integration test against in-memory store
- [x] docs/notes and Console usage example

Non-goals: this PR does not replace the full performance profile (latency P95/P99 histograms) or attempt automated rollout decisions. It only produces contextual hints and a rollback draft for operator review.

Backward compatibility: new index files are stored as sibling artifacts; older tooling will ignore them. Feature is guarded by a feature flag that defaults to off for existing customers.

Notes for reviewers: focus on (a) determinism of the prefix fingerprint, (b) size of stored index (goal <= 2KB per variant), and (c) generated rollback text quality and privacy implications for sample prefixes. The rollback drafter outputs redacted examples by default and includes a pointer to the full diagnostic bundle behind RBAC.

Deployment: staged rollout via feature flag. We plan to enable for Canary + Internal first, then flip for larger customers after one week of internal telemetry.

review_comments: Miguel Chen (2025-11-13): Nice approach. Two immediate asks: ensure prefix fingerprinting is stable across tokenizer upgrades (we should include tokenizer version and normalization in the fingerprint) and add a simple benchmark that asserts index serialization < 2KB.
Asha Patel (2025-11-14): Reply: added tokenizer_version into the fingerprint and normalization step plus a small size assertion in test_affordance_indexer. See commit d4e5f6g.
Riley Brooks (2025-11-15): Tests look good. Please add a note in docs about how the index is redacted and how to request the full diagnostic bundle.
Asha Patel (2025-11-16): Added docs section and API note; update included in docs/onboard/affordance-index.md.
Sara Nguyen (2025-11-18): Security requested provenance signature for generated rollback drafts to avoid tampering in internal pipelines. Can you add a lightweight HMAC hook?
Asha Patel (2025-11-19): Added optional HMAC signing with key lookup path (feature flagged). Tests added to assert signature presence when enabled.
release_notes:
- Introduce an affordance index produced during model onboarding to capture typical input distributions and recommended runtime affordances.
- Add a rollback drafter that synthesizes rollback changelogs and remediation checklists when regressions are detected.
- Feature gated and off by default; rollout planned for Canary and Internal customers.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag onboard.affordance_index.enabled=false by default. Index storage is compact JSON.gz; monitor registry.index.size and registry.index.generate.latency. Initial rollout to canary only.
qa_instructions: 1) Enable feature flag for a test org. 2) Onboard a small variant with synthetic sample traces. 3) Assert index artifact is created and size < 2KB. 4) Trigger rollback_drafter with a synthetic 'regression' event and verify generated changelog is redacted and HMAC-signed (if signing enabled).
risk_notes: Low-medium: introduces additional artifacts stored per-variant and a new read endpoint. All changes behind feature flag; signing optional. Watch storage growth and edge-case tokenizers for nondeterministic fingerprints.
